decisions.statement: The update stamp of every row in the trusted window is asked for.
Each stamp is compared against the watermark this copy has.
A minute where nothing changed costs one call.
Only the rows that moved are refetched.
Rows are refetched in batches rather than every row at once.
A row naming an account this copy has not landed is left alone.
A row naming an unknown category keeps the category that row has until the daily full run.
A tag no tag page has is left off rather than landed unnamed.
A row Monarch no longer lists inside the window fetched is retired.
The rules are run only where something landed.
A row claimed by more than one rule leaves the run non-zero.

definition: the Monarch rows whose update time has moved, landed a minute at a time
